task_message:
Case M19: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 260x260x360 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M19 is complete. Summary of the workflow:

- **Finding the lesion:** `seg_open` plus axial, sagittal and coronal sheets showed a large, lobulated T2-hyperintense mass in the left posterior thigh (hamstring compartment), spanning ~90 mm craniocaudally.
- **Initial segmentation:** A positive point on the bright tumor core (axial 220) produced a 114 mL mask covering the mass.
- **Correction:** Accepted an intensity-based candidate (C1) that added the tumor's less intense peripheral rim/inferior extension (+19 mL), while rejecting implausible proposals (isolated specks, huge rings of normal muscle).
- **Refinement:** `seg_refine` smoothed the painted/candidate boundary, trimming ~9.5 mL of overshoot at the poles.
- **Verification:** Checked axial slices at the poles (158/165/175/235/245/255), zoomed mask views in all three planes, and the final 5-slices-per-plane review — no tumor tissue beyond either end, no stray components, and the outline follows the lesion boundary throughout.

Final mask: single component, 124.2 mL, extent axial 159–248, coronal 97–153, sagittal 54–114. Saved with medium confidence (the only judgment call was the faint non-enhancing periphery at the distal pole, which was left out as edema).
